title: Broken internal link
evidence: https://shop.example.com/error returned HTTP 500. Linked from 1 page(s), anchor text "Status": https://shop.example.com/
explanation: One or more pages link to an internal URL that returned an error status.
suggestion: Update or remove the broken links on the linking pages, or redirect the broken URL to a relevant live page.

title: Missing title tag
evidence: No <title> element found in the HTML <head>.
explanation: The page has no <title> element. Titles are a primary source for the clickable headline in search results.
suggestion: Add a unique, descriptive <title> (roughly 30–60 characters) that includes the page's main topic.

title: Broken internal link
evidence: https://shop.example.com/missing returned HTTP 404. Linked from 2 page(s), anchor text "Gift cards": https://shop.example.com/, https://shop.example.com/blog
explanation: One or more pages link to an internal URL that returned an error status.
suggestion: Update or remove the broken links on the linking pages, or redirect the broken URL to a relevant live page.

title: Redirect loop or excessive redirects
evidence: Redirect loop detected. Hops: https://shop.example.com/loop-a → https://shop.example.com/loop-b
explanation: The URL redirects in a loop or exceeds the redirect limit, so it never resolves to a page.
suggestion: Fix the redirect rules so the URL resolves to a single final page in one hop.

title: Redirect chain
evidence: 2 redirects: https://shop.example.com/old-page (301) → https://shop.example.com/redirect-mid (301) → https://shop.example.com/about (200)
explanation: The URL passes through two or more redirects before reaching the final page. Chains slow users down and waste crawl budget.
suggestion: Point the first URL (and any internal links to it) directly at the final destination with a single 301 redirect.

title: Insecure (HTTP) resources on HTTPS page
evidence: 1 insecure resource(s), e.g. http://cdn.example.net/bowl.jpg
explanation: This HTTPS page loads images, scripts, stylesheets or frames over plain HTTP. Browsers may block them or show warnings.
suggestion: Load these resources over HTTPS (or use protocol-relative/relative URLs).

title: Missing viewport meta tag
evidence: No <meta name="viewport"> tag found.
explanation: No <meta name="viewport"> was found, so mobile browsers may render the page at desktop width.
suggestion: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

title: Images missing alt attribute
evidence: 1 of 2 images have no alt attribute. Examples: https://shop.example.com/img/team.jpg
explanation: Some elements have no alt attribute at all. Alt text is needed for screen readers and helps image search. (Empty alt="" is correct for decorative images and is not flagged.)
suggestion: Add descriptive alt text to meaningful images, and alt="" to purely decorative ones.

title: Page is set to noindex
evidence: X-Robots-Tag: noindex
explanation: A robots meta tag or X-Robots-Tag header tells search engines not to index this page. If unintentional, the page cannot appear in search results.
suggestion: If the page should rank, remove 'noindex' from the robots meta tag / X-Robots-Tag header. If intentional, no action is needed.

title: Missing H1 heading
evidence: No <h1> element found in the HTML.
explanation: No <h1> was found in the HTML. A clear main heading helps users and search engines understand the page topic. (Content rendered only by JavaScript is not visible to this crawler.)
suggestion: Add one visible <h1> that states the page's main topic.

title: Missing meta description
evidence: No <meta name="description"> tag found.
explanation: No meta description was found. Search engines may generate a snippet from page text instead; a written description gives you more control over the snippet.
suggestion: Add a unique meta description (roughly 50–160 characters) summarising the page and its value.

title: Duplicate meta description across pages
evidence: "Handmade ceramics and homeware, designed in small batches and shipped worldwide from our studio." is shared by 2 pages: https://shop.example.com/, https://shop.example.com/contact
explanation: Several crawled pages share exactly the same meta description.
suggestion: Write a distinct description for each page.

title: Duplicate meta description across pages
evidence: "Browse our full range." is shared by 2 pages: https://shop.example.com/products, https://shop.example.com/blog
explanation: Several crawled pages share exactly the same meta description.
suggestion: Write a distinct description for each page.

title: Duplicate meta description across pages
evidence: "Handmade ceramics and homeware, designed in small batches and shipped worldwide from our studio." is shared by 2 pages: https://shop.example.com/, https://shop.example.com/contact
explanation: Several crawled pages share exactly the same meta description.
suggestion: Write a distinct description for each page.

title: Duplicate meta description across pages
evidence: "Browse our full range." is shared by 2 pages: https://shop.example.com/products, https://shop.example.com/blog
explanation: Several crawled pages share exactly the same meta description.
suggestion: Write a distinct description for each page.

title: Missing canonical tag
evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> found.
explanation: No rel="canonical" link was found. Canonicals help consolidate duplicate URLs (e.g. with tracking parameters).
suggestion: Add a self-referencing <link rel="canonical"> with the preferred absolute URL.

title: Internal links point to redirecting URLs
evidence: https://shop.example.com/old-page redirects (301) to https://shop.example.com/about. Linked from 1 page(s): https://shop.example.com/
explanation: Internal links point to a URL that redirects. It works, but costs an extra request for every visit and crawl.
suggestion: Update the internal links to point directly at the final URL.

title: Missing html lang attribute
evidence: <html> element has no lang attribute.
explanation: The <html> element has no lang attribute, which helps screen readers and language detection.
suggestion: Add the page language, e.g. <html lang="en">.

title: Skipped heading level
evidence: H2 "Bowls" is followed by H4 "Large bowls".
explanation: The heading hierarchy skips a level (for example an H2 followed directly by an H4). This mainly affects accessibility and document structure.
suggestion: Use heading levels in order (H1 → H2 → H3) to reflect the content outline.

title: Title may be truncated in results
evidence: Title (98 chars): "The Example Shop Journal: Stories, Studio Notes, Glazing Experiments and Behind-the-Scenes Updates"
explanation: The title is longer than 60 characters. Search engines truncate by pixel width, so this is an approximation, not a hard limit.
suggestion: Move the most important words to the front and aim for roughly 30–60 characters.

title: Multiple H1 headings
evidence: 2 H1 headings: "Journal"; "Latest posts"
explanation: The page has more than one <h1>. This is valid HTML and not a confirmed problem, but a single main heading usually gives a clearer structure.
suggestion: Consider keeping one H1 for the main topic and using H2/H3 for sections.

title: Meta description length outside typical range
evidence: Meta description (22 chars): "Browse our full range."
explanation: The description is outside the commonly displayed range of about 50–160 characters. This is guidance only; snippet length varies.
suggestion: Aim for roughly 50–160 characters with the key message first.

title: Meta description length outside typical range
evidence: Meta description (22 chars): "Browse our full range."
explanation: The description is outside the commonly displayed range of about 50–160 characters. This is guidance only; snippet length varies.
suggestion: Aim for roughly 50–160 characters with the key message first.

title: Very short title
evidence: Title (4 chars): "Shop"
explanation: The title is shorter than 15 characters, which may not describe the page well.
suggestion: Expand the title to describe the page's topic (and brand, if useful).

title: Low word count
evidence: 5 words of visible text found in the HTML.
explanation: Fewer than 150 words of text were found in the HTML. Word count is not a ranking factor by itself, and pages rendered with JavaScript may appear thin to this crawler.
suggestion: Check whether the page fully answers its visitors' needs; add useful content if it does not.

title: Low word count
evidence: 3 words of visible text found in the HTML.
explanation: Fewer than 150 words of text were found in the HTML. Word count is not a ranking factor by itself, and pages rendered with JavaScript may appear thin to this crawler.
suggestion: Check whether the page fully answers its visitors' needs; add useful content if it does not.

title: Internal URLs blocked by robots.txt
evidence: 1 internal URL(s) disallowed, e.g. https://shop.example.com/admin/login
explanation: Some internal links point to URLs disallowed by robots.txt. These were not crawled. This is often intentional (e.g. cart or admin pages).
suggestion: Confirm that each blocked path is meant to be hidden from crawlers; unblock any that should be indexed.
